say: Pricing too low is one of the most common reasons small salons struggle. A low price fills your diary but leaves you tired and broke.
First, count materials: gel, cream, bands, and extension hair if you supply it.

panel.heading: A simple pricing formula
items: Materials used on that client
Overhead share: monthly costs over clients
Your time: hours times the hourly pay you want
Add them up, then check local prices

say: Second, your overhead share. Add your monthly costs like disinfectant, washing, data and transport, and divide by the clients you expect.

panel.heading: A simple pricing formula
items: Materials used on that client
Overhead share: monthly costs over clients
Your time: hours times the hourly pay you want
Add them up, then check local prices

say: Third, your time. Hours the style takes, multiplied by the hourly pay you want.

panel.heading: A simple pricing formula
items: Materials used on that client
Overhead share: monthly costs over clients
Your time: hours times the hourly pay you want
Add them up, then check local prices

say: Add them together. That is your minimum price. Then compare with good stylists near you, at least five of them, and round to a clear figure.

panel.heading: A simple pricing formula
items: Materials used on that client
Overhead share: monthly costs over clients
Your time: hours times the hourly pay you want
Add them up, then check local prices

say: Below that minimum, you are paying to work.

panel.heading: A simple pricing formula
items: Materials used on that client
Overhead share: monthly costs over clients
Your time: hours times the hourly pay you want
Add them up, then check local prices
panel.rule: Know your minimum price and do not go below it.

say: Here is a worked example. Bisi in Lagos prices medium knotless braids, mid-back, with the client bringing her own hair. All figures are approximate.

card.title: Pricing medium knotless braids
card.note: Minimum price. Naira prices are approximate.

say: Materials like gel, mousse and bands come to about 800 naira.

card.title: Pricing medium knotless braids
card.note: Minimum price. Naira prices are approximate.

say: Her overheads are about 15,000 naira a month across about 25 clients. That is 600 naira per client.

card.title: Pricing medium knotless braids
card.note: Minimum price. Naira prices are approximate.

say: The style takes 5 hours, and she wants at least 3,000 naira an hour. That is 15,000 naira.

card.title: Pricing medium knotless braids
card.note: Minimum price. Naira prices are approximate.

say: So her minimum price is 16,400 naira. Good braiders near her charge about 18,000 to 25,000, so she sets 20,000. That leaves about 3,600 for growth.

say: WhatsApp Business is a free app with a profile and a catalogue of services. Say what makes you different in one sentence, like: neat, gentle braids with clean tools for every client.

Clear rules: lateness, cancellations, inclusions

say: Show proof, and post one photo a few times a week rather than ten at once.

say: And be clear about your rules. If a client says the price is too high, do not argue. Offer a smaller option, like bigger braids or shorter length.

say: For long styles, a small deposit protects your time. Confirm it, and every transfer, in your own banking app.

cards.d: Check every transfer and deposit in your own banking app, not a screenshot.
No edited photos, no styles you did not do, no claims that products make hair grow.
Clean tools after every client, no painful braids, no chemicals without checks and consent.

say: Write honest captions. Never post styles you did not do. Clients will notice when your work looks different.

cards.d: Check every transfer and deposit in your own banking app, not a screenshot.
No edited photos, no styles you did not do, no claims that products make hair grow.
Clean tools after every client, no painful braids, no chemicals without checks and consent.

say: And as you get busy, keep the rules: tools cleaned after every client, no styling over infection, no painful braids, and no chemical service without a scalp check, strand test and consent.

say: Split your next 90 days into three blocks. Days 1 to 30: build skill and visibility, with your WhatsApp catalogue set up.

panel.heading: 90 days in three blocks
items: Days 1 to 30: skill and visibility
Days 31 to 60: steady paying clients
Days 61 to 90: grow and stabilise

say: Days 31 to 60: steady paying clients, collect day-7 photos, and review your prices.

panel.heading: 90 days in three blocks
items: Days 1 to 30: skill and visibility
Days 31 to 60: steady paying clients
Days 61 to 90: grow and stabilise

say: Days 61 to 90: grow and stabilise. Make targets fit your real hours.
For example, Hauwa in Abuja has about 56 hours a month. She plans 8 clients, then 12, then 15, leaving time for practice and rest.

panel.heading: 90 days in three blocks

say: To remember. Same angles, daylight and a plain background. Consent before every photo. Price equals materials, plus overhead share, plus your time. Offer a smaller option instead of cutting your price. And set targets that fit your real hours.

Targets that fit your real hours
